protocol: Replace the obsolete current_fixed_ratio bank expert with the scored deployed_mean_block control, then append five TabPFN 3.5-fast feature-pool predictions as ordinary keyed experts. Compare the legacy and extended banks using only all-expert equal means and nested fold-excluded forward-selected equal-weight subsets. Inner held-fold predictions select subset size; the outer held fold is untouched by member and size selection. No manual blend location or percentage is searched. Full TabPFN 3.5 is excluded as a near-duplicate confirmation backend (fast/full OOF Spearman 0.97142).
